clock_model: Ideal reference DQS; both edges sample once per data UI. No clock/DQS channel was simulated.
clock_alignment: Same fixed 25 ps receiver alignment already used by saved eyes; no per-layout or waveform optimization.

illustrative_valid_voltage_criterion.definition: Expected finite-pattern bit must meet these explanatory voltage limits. These are not device input thresholds.

interpretation: Qualitative bus-timing illustration, not measured setup/hold, jitter, DDR timing, eye-mask or compliance margin.

close.green_window: Saved switching voltage meets illustrative limits; the eye requires all observed high/low bits to meet them.

separated.green_window: Saved switching voltage meets illustrative limits; the eye requires all observed high/low bits to meet them.
